description: Abstract base class providing a generic implementation for substitution strategies based on the type of WithDittoHeaders. Implements common substitution logic for Subjects, PolicyEntries, Policies, AclEntries, AccessControlLists, and Things.

classes.name: AbstractTypedSubstitutionStrategy
classes.description: Provides a type-specific matching and various static substitution methods for policy, ACL, and Thing objects based on headers.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if the given WithDittoHeaders instance is of the concrete type handled by this strategy.

methods.name: substituteSubjects
methods.description: Replaces subject IDs within Subjects collection based on substitution algorithm and headers.

methods.name: substitutePolicyEntry
methods.description: Creates a new PolicyEntry with substituted subject IDs if changes are detected.

methods.name: substitutePolicy
methods.description: Creates a new Policy with substituted entries based on the provided headers and substitution algorithm.

methods.name: substitutePolicyEntries
methods.description: Iterates over PolicyEntries, substituting each and replacing in the iterable if changed.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces a PolicyEntry at a specific index within an iterable collection, returning a new iterable.

methods.name: substituteAclEntry
methods.description: Creates a new AclEntry with substituted subject ID if changed.

methods.name: substituteAcl
methods.description: Iterates over ACL entries, substituting each and updating the ACL collection.

methods.name: substituteThing
methods.description: Creates a new Thing with a substituted AccessControlList, if modifications are needed.
